protocol.forecast_identity: Rebuilt from archive plus capture through produce_football_forecast, the served football_team_share_v1 pipeline. No served artifact was read. Weeks beyond the fifth are not live_football_forecast_v1 and are never written under a football artifact root.
protocol.self_parity: served weeks equal in the extension at atol 1e-10; week-range invariance only
protocol.availability: captured state held in every week; a first-week difference moving a held player priced below one is labelled availability_driven
protocol.prices: buy equals sell at captured prices; purchase rebasing is inert; the opt-in acquisition accounting stays at its default None in every arm
protocol.squads: Constructed by optimize_squad on the availability-applied first week at 60 deterministic units, linearization 2, proof required; budgets/funds/FT [(1000, 1000, 1), (900, 900, 0)]; not owner holdings, not the squads of earlier records

budget.wall_stopped: FAILED, never read; no budget is raised after a result

arms.window_then_continue: window solve blind to the tail, then a continuation over the tail from its end state
arms.rolling_one_week: sequential one-week solves with the same handoff, the canonical control; transfer counts, paid transfers, reversals and net points reported apart

protocol.reading_rule: delta is defined only when window and continuation are OPTIMAL; a negative delta is unproved_shortfall, never a loss; the lookahead bound gives an upper bound on the in-forecast gain; the primary finding is how often the first-week action changed

dropped.tail_plus_three: no declared reason; the served tail replaces it
dropped.chips: an unpriced right is spent inside any window solve, so the control is degenerate

protocol.order: per case, control arms first on even indices and lookahead first on odd

forecast_documents.note: Both documents come from produce_football_forecast on the same capture and archive; the served one is live_football_forecast_v1 as the builder would write it, the extended one carries the same header with more weeks and is not that contract.

measured_source.note: The protocol's source hashes are of that commit. After the run the compaction was widened to keep each path's per-week moves in this record and the table prints the bound column to three decimals; the forecast_documents block and this measured_source block were added by hand from the run's own served and extended documents, fingerprints cross-checked against the protocol, and the runner's compact.json does not carry them. No solve, input, delta, status or label changed, and the local results' sha256 above is unchanged; the review corrections of 2026-10-02 (review_corrections) rewrote every pair's gain_upper_bound by the lookahead's rounding envelope and added the tie_envelope and rounded_bound_minus_control fields, and the corrections of 2026-10-05 (review_corrections_2) changed wording and the field's name only.

hold_probe_accounting.measured_run: Every protected solve also ran a hold probe with its own one-unit cap outside its main-search cap. The control's two solves and the lookahead's one therefore had equal main-search caps, not equal total caps.
hold_probe_accounting.probe_usage: Not recovered and not inferred from the cap. The run wrote each solve only through solve_record, which at the measured source keeps no probe field, so neither this record nor the retained local results hold it.
hold_probe_accounting.runner_after_review: Each protected solve reserves its probe inside its share, so the declared totals are what each arm may spend, and its record keeps the probe's usage and cap beside the main search's.

rounding.basis: The solver's objective rounds each player-week's points half up to 0.001, once; with no bench weight a week's lineup carries eleven starter terms and the captain's term again, so a path's scaled objective and its unrounded rescore differ by at most 12 x 0.0005 points a week.
rounding.proof_rule_after_review: A proved lookahead below a proved control by at most twice that, per forecast week, is tie_within_rounding; only a shortfall beyond it is a code defect.
rounding.gain_upper_bound: The solver's bound on its rounded objective, plus the lookahead's own envelope, less the control's rescore. rounded_bound_minus_control keeps the earlier figure.
rounding.labels_changed: None. No lookahead solve proved optimal, so the proof rule never applied, and every delta, status and label is as measured.

review_corrections_2.reversals: The record counts player reversals: one for each incoming player this path sold earlier and one for each outgoing player it bought earlier, so a swap back counts two. The markdown read them as a share of the transfers; it now says player reversals and gives the transfers that reverse at least one player (8 of 14 and 8 of 13 for the rolling control), recounted from the per-week moves in this record.
review_corrections_2.post_measurement_wording: The post-measurement note said no number changed; 345912fd had rewritten gain_upper_bound and added fields, as review_corrections says. Both sentences now name what changed.

field_renamed.reason: The field holds the two-path tie threshold (0.060 over five weeks, 0.168 over fourteen); the one-path envelope the markdown calls the rounding envelope (0.030 and 0.084) is half of it.

review_corrections_2.label_pair_defect_check: The defect check now fires on a proved lookahead below any control beyond the envelope, whatever the controls' proofs, because the control path is feasible for the lookahead's model either way. No lookahead of this run proved optimal, so no label moved.
review_corrections_2.declared_section_edit: f785d5a0 added the measured 0.0021 figure (the rounded bound against the rescore on the four proved solves) to the reading rule's text after the run; the post-measurement section now lists it.
